description: This file defines the class PackageManagerUpdateProcessor, which extends UpdateProcessor to handle project update fetching within Drupal's package manager module. It includes methods for retrieving project data and processing fetch tasks.

classes.name: PackageManagerUpdateProcessor
classes.description: A final class extending UpdateProcessor to handle project update fetching in Drupal's package manager module.

methods.name: getProjectData
methods.description: Retrieves project data by name, fetching from cache or initiating a fetch if not available.

methods.name: processFetchTask
methods.description: Overrides parent method to process a fetch task while preserving the 'update.last_check' state.
